frontal_spatial_matrix.muzzle_spot_diameter: Individual spots on the muzzle exhibit a pixel area approximately 10-15% of the total area of the nasal pad.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Artificial gray/white identification tag fixed to the right ear pinna.
other_distinctive_markers: Eyes are closed/tightly squinted; presence of high-contrast facial vibrissae (whiskers) against a light background.
